tasks.title: Scaffold rbac.py + org_access + program_visibility
tasks.notes: Module docstring (R-003/open-aggregate caveat on program_visibility as a veto gate not a roster source, hardcoded governance tuple rationale, PersonaResolutionError/PersonaNotFoundError fail-closed contract — Documentation requirements 'Inline code comments'). _GOVERNANCE_PERSONAS: tuple[str, ...] = ('architect', 'product-manager', 'developer') constant (D-04) — defined here even though only governance_visibility (T-04) reads it, so TC-24 (module-source inspection) can run standalone. Shared internal helpers introduced here and reused by every later task: a fail-closed persona-resolution wrapper implementing D-01 (catches PersonaResolutionError -> HTTPException(403) + ERROR log; PersonaNotFoundError -> HTTPException(403) + INFO log, per AUTH-03-FR-1) and a structured-logging helper enforcing the exact per-event field allowlist + literal 'authorized'/'denied' outcome strings (D-02, AUTH-03-FR-2). org_access(current_user): persona == 'cio' via app.state.persona_resolver.resolve(current_user.role), emits rbac_check_org_access (both outcomes). program_visibility(current_user, program_id): open-aggregate pass-through per D-03 — never reads current_user.programs, never branches on program_id, no persona resolution, emits no log event. Test file scaffold in the same task (test-driven, C-5): CurrentUser fixture builder, a stub persona resolver test double (resolve() configurable to return a persona or raise PersonaResolutionError/PersonaNotFoundError), and a _capture_logger context manager attached to app.core.rbac, mirroring tests/unit/test_persona_resolver.py's _RecordCapturingHandler/_capture_logger idiom. Covers AUTH-03-TC-01, TC-02, TC-03, TC-04, TC-17, TC-18, TC-20, TC-24, TC-27, TC-28. D-06: the locked contract signature (current_user only, plus program_id/target_*_id where needed -- no Request, no resolver param) leaves no room to thread app.state.persona_resolver through the call. rbac.py instead exposes module-level `_persona_resolver: PersonaResolver | None = None` plus `configure(persona_resolver: PersonaResolver) -> None` (sets the module global); the fail-closed wrapper reads it via a private `_resolver()` accessor that raises RuntimeError('rbac.configure() was never called') if still None -- a loud, explicit misconfiguration signal rather than a silent default-permit. main.py's create_app() calls `rbac.configure(app.state.persona_resolver)` immediately after constructing the PersonaResolver (F-05). AUTH-03's own unit tests call `rbac.configure(stub)` directly before exercising a check -- same direct-module-attribute-assignment idiom tests/unit/test_persona_resolver.py already uses (`monkeypatch.setattr(persona_resolver, '_TIER3_TIMEOUT_SECONDS', 0.05)`), not a Request-scoped or FastAPI Depends() mechanism.

tasks.title: Add individual_usage_visibility
tasks.notes: individual_usage_visibility(current_user, target_user_id): passes when target_user_id == current_user.user_id (no persona resolution needed on the self path); otherwise resolves persona via the T-01 fail-closed helper and passes only if persona == 'cio', else raises HTTPException(403) and logs individual_view_denied (denial only, per FR-2 allowlist {user_id, target_user_id, outcome, timestamp}). Reuses T-01's fail-closed wrapper and logging helper — no new persona-resolution or logging pattern introduced here. Predecessor on T-01 is a same-file serialization edge (F-01/F-02 both written by T-01), not a logical dependency of individual_usage_visibility on org_access/program_visibility. Covers AUTH-03-TC-05, TC-06, TC-07, TC-22.

tasks.title: Add member_in_program_visibility (cascades through program_visibility)
tasks.notes: member_in_program_visibility(current_user, program_id, target_member_id): calls program_visibility(current_user, program_id) FIRST (AUTH-03-FR-4) — a denial there propagates immediately without evaluating self-or-cio, even when target_member_id == current_user.user_id (AUTH-03-TC-10 asserts this call order with a spy, not just the end-to-end outcome). If program_visibility passes: passes when target_member_id == current_user.user_id, else resolves persona via the T-01 helper and passes only if persona == 'cio', else HTTPException(403) + member_view_denied (denial only, {user_id, program_id, target_member_id, outcome, timestamp}). Predecessor on T-02 is the same-file serialization edge (F-01/F-02); logically this check depends on program_visibility (T-01), reached transitively through T-02->T-01. Covers AUTH-03-TC-08, TC-09, TC-10, TC-23.

tasks.title: Add governance_visibility (persona gate + conditional program_visibility cascade)
tasks.notes: governance_visibility(current_user, program_id=None): resolves persona via the T-01 fail-closed helper (AUTH-03-TC-19 confirms FR-1 applies here too, not only org_access) and passes only if persona in _GOVERNANCE_PERSONAS (D-04); denies with HTTPException(403) + rbac_check_governance_visibility outcome=denied otherwise. When persona passes AND program_id is given: the persona gate runs BEFORE program_visibility (AUTH-03-FR-4) — call order verified with an ordered call-recorder (AUTH-03-TC-16) and short-circuit verified with a spy that must never be called when persona itself denies (AUTH-03-TC-15); program_visibility's own denial then propagates even though persona passed (AUTH-03-TC-14). Success logs rbac_check_governance_visibility outcome=authorized ({user_id, persona, outcome, timestamp}, same allowlist as org_access per D-02). Covers AUTH-03-TC-11, TC-12, TC-13, TC-14, TC-15, TC-16, TC-19, TC-21.
